title: Sordland/Turn04/InT_TaurusHighwayIssue
description: Half of the first infrastructure project has been completed. But further progress has been halted due to an issue which the player must choose to solve in a way. The player enters a meeting in Lenkurg. Dependant on each corporation a different issue appears and all of them have different absolute solutions or failures leading to making the opening deadline or missing it by two months.

entries.dialogueText: “After the terrible Morbel mine disaster, workers have been on edge. Vetoing the Workers' Rights bill certainly did not help with the situation either.”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“Strikers primary demand is for the..."
entries.dialogueText: “Strikers primary demand is for the bill to be reinstated. We have to solve the issue or the construction will stay halted longer.”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl

entries.dialogueText: “Taurus Holding has reached out to us and requested more funds.”

entries.menuText: “We could replace the striking workers.”

entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“We can avoid many more strikes if..."
entries.dialogueText: “We can avoid many more strikes if we show them that we can adapt and change.”

entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“That is an option but I am not sur..."
entries.dialogueText: “That is an option but I am not sure how helpful it will be. Passing the bill will be respecting their demands.”

entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“We can't stand idle and we can't a..."
entries.dialogueText: “We can't stand idle and we can't allow our stubbornness on laws to allow a few strikers to hold the construction.”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“I agree with Lileas. Doubt sitting..."
entries.dialogueText: “I agree with Lileas. Doubt sitting idly will help in this case.”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“This could be the best choice to h..."
entries.dialogueText: “This could be the best choice to handle this swiftly.”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“This will only serve to rile up th..."
entries.dialogueText: “This will only serve to rile up the strikers even more. We might end up with a bigger mess.”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“We need to show people that we can..."
entries.dialogueText: “We need to show people that we can finish this project, our first mega project, on time.”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“However, following the veto, we ha..."
entries.dialogueText: “However, following the veto, we have ceased the implementation of the policy and disbanded the expert team, resulting in a potential increase in the cost of the bill if new teams are to be established.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Absolutely not. I will not let a f..."
entries.dialogueText: “Absolutely not. I will not let a few strikers decide the future of our country.”
entries.menuText: “Absolutely not. I will not let a few strikers decide the future of our country.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“You have a point.”"
entries.dialogueText: “You have a point.”
entries.menuText: “You have a point.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“We need to cut the head of the sna..."
entries.dialogueText: “We need to cut the head of the snake to truly stop this issue by replacing the strikers.”
entries.menuText: “We need to cut the head of the snake to truly stop this issue by replacing the strikers.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“I disagree. If we don't change our..."
entries.dialogueText: “I disagree. If we don't change our laws, this will lower the trust in our government and cause stability issues.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“A strong government can backtrack..."
entries.dialogueText: “A strong government can backtrack on its decisions and accept it was wrong.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“Making an example of the strikers..."
entries.dialogueText: “Making an example of the strikers is wrong. We need to tackle the root of the issue.”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl

entries.dialogueText: “What is your decision then, Mr. President?”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“How should we handle the strikes?”"
entries.dialogueText: “How should we handle the strikes?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“We will begin the procedure to pas..."
entries.dialogueText: “We will begin the procedure to pass the vetoed Workers' Rights bill.”
entries.menuText: “We will begin the procedure to pass the vetoed Workers' Rights bill. [-2 Government Budget]”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I'm not worried. Let's just wait i..."
entries.dialogueText: “I'm not worried. Let's just wait it out. They will stop at one point and everything will be alright.”
entries.menuText: “I'm not worried. Let's just wait it out. They will stop at one point and everything will be alright.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Order Taurus Holding to replace th..."
entries.dialogueText: “Order Taurus Holding to replace the strikers with new workers. This should fix our issue.”
entries.menuText: “Order Taurus Holding to replace the strikers with new workers. This should fix our issue.”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“I'm not sure about this but as you..."
entries.dialogueText: “I'm not sure about this but as you wish.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“Glad we made this choice.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Glad we made this choice.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“Respect for the state will increas..."
entries.dialogueText: “Respect for the state will increase. Standing by the people is the right choice.”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“Very well. Hopefully the backlash..."
entries.dialogueText: “Very well. Hopefully the backlash doesn't affect us too much.”

entries.dialogueText: “This is unacceptable. I should have known that a cheaper offer wasn't technically possible. We wouldn't have this issue if you decided to go with SSC instead of Taurus.”

entries.dialogueText: “Now they are requesting more funds to be able to cover the increased costs. If we don't provide we could face a delay which would endanger our reputation.”

entries.dialogueText: “If we spend the extra amount they are requesting, we might miss other opportunities.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf

entries.dialogueText: “It's unfortunate that we were put in this spot. Do we really have a choice here?”

entries.dialogueText: “None of us do and this is specifically why there was a brief about each companies and the potential issues.”

entries.dialogueText: “They need it for unforeseen expenses that came from the new Workers' Rights Bill. A couple of shipment companies they had contract with also increased costs on the necessary materials.”
